title: A more useful app showcase
summary:
The app garden got easier to browse, Polly gained an API interface, and a new moderation model joined the lineup.

The showcase gained fuller descriptions, BYOP and New filters, and badges for BYOP and Trending apps. Daily request counts now help sort the catalog. Two community additions show the range: a Discord anti-raid bot and a voice-driven Roblox game.

A standalone service now exposes Polly through `POST /v1/chat/completions`, accepting text and image messages and running its tool-calling loop before returning a final response. It also provides model and health endpoints; streaming is not supported.

The team added `qwen-safety`, based on Qwen3Guard-Gen-8B, with the alias `qwen3guard-gen-8b`. The model table also shows available price badges when other price fields are missing.

highlights.title: Find your next app
highlights.text: Browse fuller app descriptions, filter for New or Bring Your Own Pollen apps, and spot Trending apps by badge. [Explore the showcase](https://pollinations.ai).

highlights.title: Polly gets an API
highlights.text: A standalone OpenAI-compatible service lets clients send text or image messages to Polly through `POST /v1/chat/completions` and receive a final answer after its tool calls. Streaming is not supported.

highlights.title: Qwen3Guard text moderation
highlights.text: Use `qwen-safety`, based on Qwen3Guard-Gen-8B, for text moderation. It also accepts the alias `qwen3guard-gen-8b`. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=qwen-safety).
